configurable_props.name: conversation
configurable_props.label: Channel
configurable_props.description: Select a public or private channel, or a user or group

configurable_props.name: text
configurable_props.label: Text
configurable_props.description: Text of the message to send (see Slack's [formatting docs](https://api.slack.com/reference/surfaces/formatting)). This field is usually necessary, unless you're providing only attachments instead.

configurable_props.name: as_user
configurable_props.label: Send as User
configurable_props.description: Pass true to update the message as the authed user. Bot users in this context are considered authed users.

configurable_props.name: attachments
configurable_props.label: Attachments
configurable_props.description: A JSON-based array of structured attachments, presented as a URL-encoded string (e.g., `[{"pretext": "pre-hello", "text": "text-world"}]`).
